dataset: TUM Freiburg1 xyz, real Kinect RGB-D input
citation: J. Sturm et al., A Benchmark for the Evaluation of RGB-D SLAM Systems, IROS 2012
rendering: Source RGB pixels and actual saved CUDA raycasts unchanged. Measured depth is colour-mapped for display over fixed 500–3500 mm; invalid zero pixels black. No input filtering, interpolation, inpainting or synthesized frames.
frame_mapping: manifest frame i+1 -> recorded(i+1), paired RGB from manifest, reconstruction-i.ppm (zero-based i, four digits)
trajectory_error: Post-run motion-capture comparison after initial anchoring; no fitted alignment. Not a surface-geometry error.
